title: Huangqin Qingre Chubi Capsule improves rheumatoid arthritis accompanied depression through the Wnt1/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Chen; Xue, Qiuyun; Li, Hui; Peng, Yanhui; Wu, Yajie; Yuan, Meiling; Duan, Qiangjun; Hong, Xinghui; Chen, Guangliang; Liao, Faxue; Wu, Peng; Miao, Chenggui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药胶囊通过Wnt1/β-catenin信号通路改善类风湿关节炎伴抑郁，虽含分子动力学模拟但对象为药物-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIM OF THE STUDY: Research on the mechanism of Huangqin Qingre Chubi Capsules (HQC) in improving rheumatoid arthritis accompanied depression (RA-dep) model rats. METHODS: We employed real-time qPCR (RT-qPCR), western blotting (WB), confocal microscopy, bioinformatics, and other methods to investigate the anti-RA-dep effects of HQC and its underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: HQC alleviated the pathological indexes of inflammation and depression in RA-dep model rats, decreased the levels of tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha, interleukin (IL)-1beta and IL-6, increased the levels of norepinephrine(NE) and serotonin(5-HT), and improved the injury of hippocampus. The analysis of network pharmacology suggests that HQC may target the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway in the treatment of RA-dep. Furthermore, molecular dynamics simulations revealed a strong affinity between HQC and the Wnt1 molecule. RT-qPCR and Western Blot (WB) experiments confirmed the critical role of the Wnt1/beta-catenin signaling pathway in the treatment of RA-dep model rats with HQC. In vitro, the HQC drug-containing serum (HQC-serum) activates the Wnt1/beta-catenin signaling pathway in hippocampal cells and, in conjunction with Wnt1, ameliorates RA-dep. In summary, HQC exerts its anti-inflammatory and antidepressant effects in the treatment of RA-dep by binding to Wnt1 and regulating the Wnt1/beta-catenin signaling pathway. CONCLUSIONS: HQC improved the inflammatory reaction and depression-like behavior of RA-dep model rats by activating Wnt1/beta-catenin signal pathway. This study revealed a new pathogenesis of RA-dep and contributes to the clinical promotion of HQC in the treatment of RA-dep.
abstract_zh: 研究目的：探讨黄芩清热除痹胶囊（HQC）改善类风湿关节炎伴抑郁（RA-dep）模型大鼠的作用机制。方法：采用实时荧光定量PCR（RT-qPCR）、蛋白质印迹法（WB）、共聚焦显微镜、生物信息学等方法研究HQC抗RA-dep的作用及其潜在机制。结果：HQC减轻了RA-dep模型大鼠的炎症和抑郁病理指标，降低了肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α、白细胞介素（IL）-1β和IL-6的水平，提高了去甲肾上腺素（NE）和5-羟色胺（5-HT）的水平，并改善了海马损伤。网络药理学分析提示，HQC可能通过靶向Wnt/β-catenin通路治疗RA-dep。此外，分子动力学模拟揭示了HQC与Wnt1分子之间具有强亲和力。RT-qPCR和蛋白质印迹（WB）实验证实了Wnt1/β-catenin信号通路在HQC治疗RA-dep模型大鼠中的关键作用。体外实验中，HQC含药血清（HQC-serum）激活海马细胞中的Wnt1/β-catenin信号通路，并与Wnt1协同改善RA-dep。总之，HQC通过结合Wnt1并调节Wnt1/β-catenin信号通路，发挥其抗炎和抗抑郁作用，从而治疗RA-dep。结论：HQC通过激活Wnt1/β-catenin信号通路，改善了RA-dep模型大鼠的炎症反应和抑郁样行为。本研究揭示了RA-dep的新发病机制，并有助于HQC在RA-dep治疗中的临床推广。
